_source: UI palette extracted from code literals (doctrine lint shrink slice 1, plan SE-COMPLETE-1012 W8-H). Single data home for the colors previously inlined in src/ui/setup.js, src/ui/settings.js, src/ui/scoreboard.js, src/ui/store.js, src/ui/weaponPicker.js, scripts/ui_menu_render.js, scripts/ui_top_panel_render.js. Values are byte-identical to the literals they replaced. Read ONLY via src/ui/theme.js (themeColor/themeValue — fail-loud, no fallbacks). Structured by ROLE; each role group carries its own _source provenance note.

text._source: Text/fill colors used across all seven surfaces. body #eef3ea was the base color on every overlay (setup.js panel, settings/store/scoreboard/menu sheets, weaponPicker strip); gold #e8c547 = setup H1 + weaponPicker head; green #9fdc7f = settings labels/active tab, scoreboard mode/hull-fill/score, store cash/column heads, menu hover + help dt, wp qty; cash #d8c86a = scoreboard rank/cash + store cost; softGreen #cfe8c5 = store row buttons + menu rows + wp store button; dim #6f8f6a = settings idle tabs + store bundle sizes (also menu archetype dim default); dimmer #4c5a48 = store disabled buttons (also topPanel dim default); blueDim #6f8f9a = wp key hints (also a topPanel editor choice); label #9fb4cc = setup section headers/row labels; error #ff6b5e = setup/settings error lists + wp status; disabledInput #8b99a9 = setup disabled legacy option inputs.
text.label: #9fb4cc

panels._source: Panel chrome: sheet backgrounds/borders/headers of the four retro sheets (settings.js, scoreboard.js, store.js, ui_menu_render.js incl. the help overlay) plus the BLUE setup box (setup.js) and the scoreboard hull bar track. sheetBg #0d130d, sheetBorder #3a5a3a, headerBg #12200f (header AND footer strips), tabStripBg #0f1a0c (settings tab strip), blueBorder #3a4a5e (setup box + weaponPicker strip borders), hullTrack #182512 (scoreboard hull bar).

rows._source: Row/list-item surfaces: dotted row separators #1e331a (scoreboard + store rows), store column divider #24401f, blue row chrome #22303f border + #0f1620 background (setup roster rows + weaponPicker items), winner/active row background #1b2f17 (scoreboard data-winner row).

buttons._source: Button styling: primaryBg/primaryText #e8c547-on-#131a24 = setup START BATTLE; actionBg/actionText/actionBorder #1b2f17-#cfe8c5-on-#3a5a3a = store per-row buy/sell buttons; doneBg/doneText/doneBorder #2a4a20-#eef3ea-on-#6a9a55 = the DONE/CLOSE footer buttons (store, scoreboard, settings); disabledText #4c5a48 = disabled store row buttons.

inputs._source: Form fields: fieldBg #0a0e14 (setup pickers/inputs, settings number+select, menu row buttons), fieldText #eef3ea, fieldBorderBlue #3a4a5e (setup fields), fieldBorderGreen #3a5a3a (settings fields).

states._source: Interactive/selection states: selectedBorder #e8c547 + selectedBg #1d2634 (weaponPicker selected weapon); hoverText #9fdc7f (menu row hover, settings active tab text); activeBg #1b2f17 (menu hover + settings active tab bg — same value as rows.activeBg, one state); activeLine #6a9a55 (settings slider accent + tab underline, scoreboard winner inset, menu focus outline, DONE button borders read via buttons.doneBorder).

archetype._source: Editor-facing archetype param data (per-element doctrine: these colors ride on the ui_menu / ui_top_panel ROOT script params — see assets/archetypes/ui_menu.json, which already carries accent/dim). topPanelColorChoices = the editor dropdown choices for ui_top_panel_render accent/status/dim params (was COLOR_CHOICES); topPanelAccentDefault #e8c547 / topPanelStatusDefault #9fdc7f / topPanelDimDefault #4c5a48 = PANEL_PARAM_DEFAULTS; menuDimDefault #6f8f6a = ui_menu_render params.dim default.
